title: Chemical change
competency: Describe chemical change and observe one in an experiment.

keywords.def: A change in chemical composition. New substances form.

en.text: A chemical change changes the chemical composition of a substance. New substances form. An iron nail going rusty, heating magnesium ribbon, a burning candle, photosynthesis and fermentation are chemical changes.

screens.title: The nail in water
screens.ask: A shiny iron nail is left in water for a few days. It turns reddish brown. Is it still just iron?
screens.after: Rust is a new substance. Iron reacted with air in the water. That is a chemical change.

screens.title: 2.4.2 Chemical change
paras: A chemical change is a change in the chemical composition of a substance.
Examples: an iron nail going rusty, heating magnesium ribbon, a burning candle, photosynthesis, fermentation.

screens.title: Experiment 2.3: Rusting of iron
paras: Put a few clean, shiny iron nails in a test tube of fresh tap water.
Set the test tube in a rack. Observe after a few days.

screens.caption: An iron nail in water rusts after a few days.

screens.title: Key words
defs: A change in chemical composition. New substances form.

screens.text: What colour forms on the iron nail?
screens.why: Iron reacts with oxygen dissolved in the water to form rust.
screens.clue: Think of an old roof sheet.

screens.text: Is rusting a physical or a chemical change?
opts: Chemical: a new substance, rust, forms
screens.ans: Chemical: a new substance, rust, forms
screens.why: Rust is new and cannot easily turn back into iron.
These form new substances. Melting and tearing are physical.

screens.text: A burning candle also melts. Which part is the chemical change?
opts: The wax burning to give carbon dioxide and water vapour
screens.ans: The wax burning to give carbon dioxide and water vapour
screens.why: Melting wax is physical. Burning forms new substances with heat and light: chemical.
screens.clue: Separate the melting from the burning.

test.why: New substances such as alcohol and carbon dioxide form.

opts: Heating magnesium ribbon until it burns
test.ans: Heating magnesium ribbon until it burns

test.ask: A chemical change changes the chemical ___ of a substance.

test.text: Which is NOT a physical change?
opts: Burning of wax in a candle
test.ans: Burning of wax in a candle
